_comment: Pre-1906 witnesses to the destroyed Archivo de California. A witness is a writer who cited or reprinted a document from the ORIGINALS, which burned in 1906; the record here is Savage's copy of the same document. Hittell entries come from an automated harvest of his four volumes joined to this catalogue by series, tomo and page (scripts: harvest_hittell.py, join_hittell_to_catalog.py); Dwinelle entries are documents he reprints in full in his ADDENDA. Only citations resolving to at most 2 candidate records are published; 471 looser matches are withheld, plus 282 that landed on records spanning more than 25 pages (volume-level abstracts, where a page match means little). `sole` marks a citation that resolved to this record alone.

_known_unbound.note: NOT drifted keys. Verified 2026-08-29 against the live export: these six Hittell citations name Prov. St. Pap. tomo XXI pages 629-671, and NO record in ANY of the 63 volumes covers those pages (ca14's XXI coverage stops at p.400). Their old doc_ids (d1080-d1130) also exceed ca14's current maximum, so they date from an earlier, larger ca14. They are therefore evidence of a COVERAGE GAP: a 19th-century historian cited manuscript pages this archive has never catalogued. Do not re-anchor them to a record; there is none. They resolve only by cataloguing PSP XXI 629-671.
